name: UCM Topology-Bearing Source-Scope Inclusion
definition: The recovered UCM readable source projection has declared source-side inputs O, Chi, A, P, Rred, S, B. Thus UCM-internal adjacency/topology, chirality, persistence, redistribution, survivability/strain, and Bandwidth belong to the full UCM source ledger T_U rather than requiring a second independent beta_ext source branch.
math: T_U(L)=Pi_read^UCM(O,Chi,A,P,Rred,S,B); beta_ext contains only downstream GR inputs not already represented in Pi_read^UCM.
